svg.title: Black Panel with White Curve III
svg.desc: Interpretive study after a visually inspected primary museum photograph. Approximate geometry; standardized vivid screen colours. Observed black square at upper left joins a white curved wedge at right. Surrounding top-right and bottom-left spaces remain transparent; depth and shadows omitted.
svg.metadata: Reference: https://www.thebroad.org/art/ellsworth-kelly/black-panel-white-curve-iii; object B-KELLY-2P89.38; reviewed 2026-10-27; not a facsimile.
